func (ToolLockMiddleware) Name() string

func (b *Builder) Loop(loop kernel.AgentLoop) *Builder

func (h afterModelHook) AfterModel(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, response *wire.Message) error

func (h afterToolHook) AfterTool(ctx context.Context, execution abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall, result *wire.ToolResult) error

func (h beforeToolHook) BeforeTool(ctx context.Context, execution abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall) error

func (h inputCommittedHook) InputCommitted(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, message wire.Message) error

func (h runEndHook) OnRunEnd(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, cause error) error

func (h runStartHook) OnRunStart(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext) error

func (h wrapModelHook) WrapModel(ctx context.Context, runtime abi.RuntimeContext, request abi.ModelRequest, emit func(wire.StreamChunk) error, next abi.ModelFunc) error

func (h wrapToolHook) WrapTool(ctx context.Context, execution abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall, next abi.ToolFunc) (wire.ToolResult, error)

func (middleware ToolLockMiddleware) WrapTool(ctx context.Context, execution abi.ToolExecutionContext, call wire.ToolCall, next abi.ToolFunc) (wire.ToolResult, error)

func (r *Registrar) ContextSource(source abi.ContextSource) error

type Agent struct {
}

type AgentAssemblySnapshot struct {
	Plugins    []PluginAssemblySnapshot `json:"plugins"`
	Tools      []string                 `json:"tools"`
	Middleware []string                 `json:"middleware"`
	Commands   []agentabi.Command       `json:"commands"`
}

type Builder struct {
}

type Finalizer interface {
	Finalize(context.Context, LateContext) ([]abi.Tool, error)
}

type LateContext struct {
	Bus             bus.Handle
	Workspace       string
	Session         abi.ConversationReader
	Model           abi.LanguageModel
	ToolDefinitions []wire.ToolDefinition
	Assembly        AgentAssemblySnapshot
}

type MemorySession struct {
}

type Plugin interface {
	Name() string
	Register(context.Context, *Registrar) error
}

type PluginAssemblySnapshot struct {
	Name              string   `json:"name"`
	Tools             []string `json:"tools"`
	FinalizedTools    []string `json:"finalized_tools"`
	Middleware        []string `json:"middleware"`
	Commands          []string `json:"commands"`
	SystemPromptCount int      `json:"system_prompt_count"`
}

type Registrar struct {
}

type ToolLockMiddleware struct{ Registry *ToolLockRegistry }

type ToolLockRegistry struct {
}

var ErrRunInProgress = errors.New("agent already running")
